newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Autoways shares down on requotation.
newsitem.headline: Autoways shares down on requotation.

text.p: Shares of Malaysia's Autoways Holdings Bhd opened lower on their requotation.
Around 15 minutes into the opening, the stock was down 40 cents to 21.60 on volume of 23,000 shares traded. It has traded between 21.0 and 22.0 ringgit.

The company, a trader in rubber-based products and machinery and also involved in construction, said on Monday a wholly-owned unit has entered into an agreement to subscribe for 70 percent equity in an Indian company building a power generating plant.
The total cost of the project in Karnataka state is estimated at $160 million.
The unit, Autoways Construction Sdn Bhd, plans to subscribe for shares in Tanir Bavi Power Company which has the rights to build a 163 megawatt barge-mounted plant in Mangalore.
The stock was suspended from December 24.
